style: Read clearly and naturally, at a moderate pace
lines: Welcome to the Undo Machine. Build a chain on the top line, then build the chain that brings every number home on the bottom line.
Press Run to send the test numbers through. Each one rides out on top and has to ride home on the bottom.
Twelve puzzles. Each one gives you a chain of machines. Your job is to bring every number home.
Start at the out end. The last thing done is the first thing to undo.
Two different numbers just came out the same. Once that happens, no machine can know which one to send back.
A gate decides which numbers may enter. Keep everything entering the fold on one side of zero, and the crash goes away.
Every number made it home. Your bottom line is the inverse.
Some numbers came home as something else. Check the lost tray to see where they ended up.
The graph shows your chain, your undo chain, and the line y equals x. Press Mirror to flip your chain across that line.
The mirror image has two points above one input. That flipped graph is not a function, so the chain can't be undone as built.
Puzzle eleven. Build a two machine chain that undoes itself, so doing it twice brings every number home.
